description: This file defines internal interfaces for the Orleans grain directory system, including partition management, client interactions, and test hooks, with methods for registration, lookup, snapshot management, and integrity checks.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryPartition
classes.description: Interface for managing grain directory partitions, including registration, lookup, deregistration, snapshot retrieval, and snapshot transfer acknowledgment.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryClient
classes.description: Interface for grain directory client operations, such as retrieving registered activations and recovering them.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryTestHooks
classes.description: Interface providing test hooks for the grain directory, such as integrity checks.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain address with a specific membership version, optionally replacing current registration.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Looks up a grain address by grain ID and membership version.

methods.name: DeregisterAsync
methods.description: Deregisters a grain address with a specific membership version.

methods.name: GetSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the grain directory partition for a given range and version.

methods.name: AcknowledgeSnapshotTransferAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges the transfer of a snapshot from a silo for a specific partition and version.

methods.name: GetRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Retrieves all registered grain addresses within a range, with optional validation.

methods.name: RecoverRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Recovers registered grain addresses within a range from a specific silo.

methods.name: CheckIntegrityAsync
methods.description: Performs an integrity check on the grain directory.
